name: Houshou Ikumi
source:
"I can draw pictures, but don't involve me in silly stuffs."

Position: Character design & original pictures

Because he lost parents in an early age, he thinks that job that requires qualifications are better so he follow the path of hairdresser. Drawing is his raison d'être and he loves games. A person with strong commitment that can't be compromised.
